| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **JPEG quality** `quality` | 50 | 1 to 100 | The quality the image was saved with, from 1 to 100, as in the IJG library that most programs use. It sets the quantization tables. |
| **Shifts per axis** `shifts` | 8 (64 grids) | 1 (1 grid), 2 (4 grids), 4 (16 grids), 8 (64 grids) | How many shifts of the 8 x 8 grid are averaged along each axis, evenly spaced. 1 re-applies JPEG on the original grid only. |
| **Channels** `channels` | Y, Cb and Cr | Y, Cb and Cr, Luma only | Which planes of the Y'CbCr of JFIF are processed. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
